## `neuro.string.fontcolor`

Instance method on `String.prototype`.

> Returns a `\<font>` HTML element and sets the color attribute value

## Signatures

```ts
fontcolor(input: { string: <receiver>; color: string; prompt?: string }): Promise<string>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `String.prototype.fontcolor` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
